title: Login scripts do not work if they are in a hidden directory or are a hidden file themselves
line: A hidden login script such as ~/.script.sh now runs at login and stays listed on the Autostart page.
explanation: AutostartModel::addScript() named the generated entry after the script file, so ~/.script.sh became ~/.config/autostart/.script.sh.desktop, a hidden file. Hidden .desktop files are skipped both by the login autostart runner and by the Autostart page's own listing, so the script never ran and disappeared from the page once it was reopened; logout scripts got a hidden symlink in plasma-workspace/shutdown the same way. The change strips leading dots from the generated entry/symlink name; the entry still executes the hidden script and the page still shows its real name. Scripts inside a hidden folder already worked.

commits.message:
kcms/autostart: run and list hidden login and logout scripts

Adding a hidden script such as ~/.script.sh created the hidden entry
.script.sh.desktop, which is never run and is skipped when the page
lists entries. Drop the leading dots from the entry and symlink names.

BUG: 478662

Subject: [PATCH] kcms/autostart: run and list hidden login and logout scripts

Adding a hidden script such as ~/.script.sh created the hidden entry
.script.sh.desktop, which is never run and is skipped when the page
lists entries. Drop the leading dots from the entry and symlink names.

BUG: 478662
---
 kcms/autostart/autostartmodel.cpp | 3 +++
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)

diff --git a/kcms/autostart/autostartmodel.cpp b/kcms/autostart/autostartmodel.cpp
index 16609b873b..49b0e77d26 100644
--- a/kcms/autostart/autostartmodel.cpp
+++ b/kcms/autostart/autostartmodel.cpp
@@ -395,6 +395,9 @@ void AutostartModel::addScript(const QUrl &url, AutostartModel::AutostartEntrySo
     }
 
     QString fileName = url.fileName();
+    while (fileName.startsWith(QLatin1Char('.'))) {
+        fileName.remove(0, 1);
+    }
 
     if (kind == AutostartModel::AutostartEntrySource::XdgScripts) {
         int lastLoginScript = -1;

review.text: Stripping leading dots from the generated autostart .desktop entry and shutdown symlink names in AutostartModel::addScript() fixes the root cause at the right layer, since both systemd-xdg-autostart-generator and QDir::Files skip dotfiles. The entry still executes the original hidden script, displays its real dot-prefixed name in the Autostart KCM, and handles filename collisions cleanly; login execution via systemd and KCM persistence/removal are well verified.

reviews.text: Stripping leading dots from the generated autostart .desktop entry and shutdown symlink names in AutostartModel::addScript() fixes the root cause at the right layer, since both systemd-xdg-autostart-generator and QDir::Files skip dotfiles. The entry still executes the original hidden script, displays its real dot-prefixed name in the Autostart KCM, and handles filename collisions cleanly; login execution via systemd and KCM persistence/removal are well verified.

This is the right root cause in the right place. addScript named the generated .desktop entry (and the logout symlink) after the script, so ~/.x.sh produced a hidden file that both the KCM listing and the login autostart skip. Stripping leading dots fixes both. The existing suggestName path still handles a clash with a visible script of the same name, and the page keeps showing the real file name. The hidden-directory half of the title already works on master (comment 2 and an earlier rig login test). The after evidence shows the entry kept after reopening the page and the script running at a real re-login. Only running a logout script at actual logout was left untested, which is a minor gap for the same naming change.
